integration_obligations.title: Full strict source negatives
integration_obligations.expectation: Foreign account/job, unconfirmed/incomplete/unavailable rows excluded; both wearers see same eligible pool.

integration_obligations.title: Automatic full batch and replay
integration_obligations.expectation: No mandatory confirmation; complete batch atomic, quota100 account-wide; fault every new write stage, no partial record/event or consumed slot.

integration_obligations.title: Wearer lifecycle and preferences
integration_obligations.expectation: Phase A active validation/archive retention, explicit selection, fail-closed isolated preferences and fingerprint3 replay remain.

integration_obligations.title: Refinement and scores
integration_obligations.expectation: All original contexts/compounds/Deny/specialists/generic/baseline, four structures, exact R/C/P/floor/Seen/cap/coverage/limits retained on final combined inputs.

integration_obligations.title: Historical reads
integration_obligations.expectation: Old and new stored evidence read with active normalizer/config loader disabled; corruption visible, no re-normalization or repair.

integration_obligations.title: UI dirty-field behaviour
integration_obligations.expectation: Keep/Cancel no request/event; explicit Unknown/false/neutral distinct; apply failure preserves draft and exact revision; raw vs selected separate.

integration_obligations.title: Browser security and pending identity
integration_obligations.expectation: Captured wearer/header/key survives reload/switch; foreign resource and copied-token durable logout denial remain; no raw reserved tag execution.

integration_obligations.title: Performance and boundaries
integration_obligations.expectation: 0/1/100 strict garments, upper-bound UTF8/sets/palette/head counts, call counts/allocation peaks; normalization once per garment, no per-candidate I/O; >100 ranking rejection remains.

integration_obligations.title: Browser layout
integration_obligations.expectation: Keyboard/focus, long labels, 360/390/768/1280/1920 widths and native200% zoom; installed Chrome; disposable authenticated synthetic adapters only.

integration_obligations.title: Complete matrix and no model claim
integration_obligations.expectation: All247 row IDs remain in B1/B2; every finite case separately labelled; no installed label/accuracy/human fashion evaluation inferred.

integration_obligations.title: Source integrity and build
integration_obligations.expectation: Frozen labels before production edits, exact B0 descendant, old manifests intact; final backend suite/frontend build/types/lint/browser hashes and native exits.

integration_obligations.title: Shared colour/edit race
integration_obligations.expectation: Primary change between preparation/update conflicts; explicit dependent reassertion requires atomic new binding. Palette mirror cannot overwrite secondary intent.

integration_obligations.title: Processing transfer/currentness
integration_obligations.expectation: Raw pre-cleanup suggestion and actual candidate owner event transfer with source subject; materialization alone creates no new human event.

integration_obligations.title: Style and reserved evidence
integration_obligations.expectation: Existing owner-style-confirmation remains optional and separately authenticated; neither typed update nor model-supplied sidecar can forge source/appearance/confirmation.

integration_obligations.title: Baseline fixture gap
integration_obligations.expectation: Repair missing wearer argument only; original malformed-mirror exception reached and passes, then focused baseline repeated before B0 changes.
